strings.en: I can read your movement patterns!
So... you move like that after all. Then!
Behold the true power of the Gespenst...!
You'll be fighting with me, Type Haken.
I'm used to handling Gespenst models.
Let's see what the Leonysis can do.
Learn the weight of life for yourself...!
Jua-Mu, that's as far as you go.
You're not watching your surroundings, Jua-Mu.
I'll have you clear the way, Jua-Mu.
The Raftclans... I'll have to deal with it.
Karo-Ran... no more need to feel each other out.
It's you who'll return to darkness, Gu-Landon.
The unexpected tends to happen often enough.
That woman... she's no mere mercenary.
So they've brought out the Baran-Schneil...!
So Golaikunru's leadership/　has come out in person...!
That formation.../　Gadisword must be desperate...!
There must have been an option besides war...
There's no guarantee the Cross Gate/　will bring Gadisword a future...!
Gadisword's future no longer/　lies with Herluga!
Herluga, the Cross Gate isn't something/　human power can fully control!
Those who lurk in the shadows of war, huh.
Debudedabide, I won't let you do as you please.
Debudedabide, whatever your goal may be...!
You mean to block our path?
It's still a Zovorg unit. Eliminating it.
That's as far as you go, Crystal Dragoon.
Crystal Dragoon,/　there's no place for you in this world.
The Dark Brain Army's strongest warrior...!
Skull Knight, follow your master into oblivion.
If we don't stop that, the Earth Sphere is finished...!
Is this battle another trial we must overcome...!
I doubt it's related to the XN Geist, but...!
This world is already out of your hands./　Disappear, XN-L!
However many times you come to the Earth Sphere,/　the outcome won't change.
A group beyond the Privy Council's influence...!
I won't let you lay a hand on those two...!
I hope this battle gives us a lead.
We won't let the Fury have their way.
Thick Cylinder confirmed. Shooting it down.
White Horn confirmed. Shooting it down.
I have to stop him no matter what...!
To open a path of retreat...!
Is that another thing eating at this world?!
I have to wipe it out, one way or another...!
We must annihilate the Lamaris quickly.
Fusing with individuals... is that their trait?
We need to hurry the purification...!
Beings harboring malice/　draw in even more negative beings...!
Is it the Cross Gate you seek? Or...
I can't have you standing there.
I won't let you go any further!
I won't give you time to fall back!
Mind if it's my turn now?
Urgh! I can't take any more!
Ngh...! I've taken too much damage...!
Damn it...!/　With this much damage...!
Ngh, not good... I can't get output up...
I can't become a real ghost just yet...!
I won't let Golaikunru have its way!
I can't let Floraga keep/　using that power forever...!
Impressive! More power than I expected...
Ugh...!/　But I can still manage this much...!
Ugh! I can't let my guard down with this one...
Tch! Not bad.../　But I won't make it that easy for you!
Not yet! I'm not going down yet!
Whoa?! Tch, that one actually stung...
Tch, you're better than I thought...!
Jua-Mu, you're not all talk, it seems.
Gu-Landon,/　power alone doesn't solve everything!
I need to do something about that scythe...!
Your loyalty to Herluga is first-rate...!
You should know full well/　how terrifying the Cross Gate is...!
Debudedabide's not all talk, it seems.
That's as far as you go, Skull Knight!
It's you who should vanish from this world, XN-L!
Even against a familiar foe,/　mounting damage is a problem.
Each one of them is fairly well trained.
I won't let Thorn set the pace...!
I can't let them latch onto me...!
If I take too long with the Lamaris,/　it could turn against us...!
Ares Geist... that's quite a blow.
You're skilled, but.../　just landing a hit won't cut it.
You've still got a long way to go.
Heh, come back when you're ready.
What's wrong? Is that all you've got?
Being a new model, its rigidity's improved too.
As expected, it handles a bit differently/　from a Personal Trooper.
A knight's skill isn't to be underestimated.
You don't seem used to that machine,/　Gu-Landon.
As expected of Gadisword's combat commander.
Don't think this will stop me, Reggiane.
You don't seem to be drawing out/　the Cross Gate's full power.
Your vaunted sorcery didn't work, it seems.
Couldn't escape the Crystal Dragoon, huh.
XN-L,/　even you can't bring about the end.
I'll need to update the Fury unit data.
If I'm struggling with that one...
It's not just bigger, it seems.
I can read your every move like a book!
I've seen right through your attack patterns!
Your attack pattern is just as I predicted.
Sorry, but that won't hit me.
Don't take this Gespenst for/　just another Personal Trooper.
Heh, this is no mass-production model.
And you call yourself head of the Agents?
Gu-Landon, the future isn't carved out by power!
Not showing any impatience, huh, Vort.
I won't let you buy time, Reggiane!
Are your eyes just for show, Skull Knight?
XN-L, your role is already over.
You're not applying your past data, it seems.
Lieutenant Yon provided that machine's data.
Heh, to fall for it so easily.
Even the Fury/　can't hit me that easily.
After a few encounters, even a Raftclans'/　patterns can be read.
I won't let Gadisword have its way.
I can't spend time destroying them one by one.
I can't let the Kaana Type multiply any further.
I can't leave the Ida Type unchecked.
Its mobility seems higher than before.
Don't underestimate a member/　of the Instructor Corps.
The Cross Gate... it seems controlled, at a glance...
An extraordinary sword, but I've read it.
The combat data from Al-Van's unit paid off.
Missile attacks won't work on me!
There's nothing I can do at this range...
Couldn't break away in time...! Here goes!
There's no reason not to follow up here!
Heh... the same timing as the old days.
This combination... my body remembers it.
Masaki... leave the rest to me.
Viletta, leave the rest to me.
Arado, don't get too far ahead!
Kota, leave the rest to me.
Ing, leave the rest to me.
Aqua, leave the rest to me.
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Calvina, leave this to me.
Good job drawing their attention, Akemi.
Lieutenant Yon, we'll handle the pursuit!
Sieg, I'll leave the rest to you.
Al-Van, leave the rest to me.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I won't let that happen so easily!
I can't let it end here!
Looks like I have to go myself...!
Viletta, leave that enemy to me!
Fall back while you can, Lieutenant Yon!
Sieg, you got a bit overeager!
A Fury knight wouldn't fall so easily!
Just as I thought, you bunched up./　In that case!
I won't let this chance slip by!
Sorry, but I'll be taking your energy!
You came right where I expected...!
This weapon isn't just for show.
Allies, fall back! Firing MAP weapon!
All targets acquired...! Here I go!
The Super Fighter guides you/　toward ill fortune.
Begone, beyond the darkest of omens!
Your luck had run out either way.
No obstacles at the access point.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
By the way... why that name just now?
Uh, was that a bad idea...?
Guided by the star of ill omen, vanish.
You didn't read far enough ahead!
Don't think I'll stay in the same spot forever!
You can't catch the Varga's speed!
